record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: If X is compact and Y has the property that every large open cover of Y can be split into two disjoint large subcovers, must the product X × Y also have Split(Λ, Λ)?

evidence.quote: Assume that X is compact and Y satisfies Split(Λ, Λ). Does X × Y satisfy Split(Λ, Λ)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a topological space. An open cover $\mathcal{U}$ of $X$ is called a *large cover* if $\mathcal{U}$ is infinite and each point of $X$ belongs to infinitely many members of $\mathcal{U}$. Denote by $\Lambda$ the family of all large open covers of $X$.

For families $\mathcal{U}, \mathcal{V}$ of open covers, the property $\mathrm{Split}(\mathcal{U},\mathcal{V})$ asserts: for every cover $\mathcal{U} \in \mathcal{U}$, there exist disjoint subfamilies $\mathcal{V}_1, \mathcal{V}_2 \subseteq \mathcal{U}$ with $\mathcal{V}_1 \cup \mathcal{V}_2 = \mathcal{U}$ (up to refinement) such that both $\mathcal{V}_1, \mathcal{V}_2 \in \mathcal{V}$.

In particular, $\mathrm{Split}(\Lambda,\Lambda)$ means that every large open cover of the space can be partitioned into two disjoint large subcovers.

Question: Assume that $X$ is a compact topological space and $Y$ is a topological space satisfying $\mathrm{Split}(\Lambda,\Lambda)$. Must the product space $X \times Y$ satisfy $\mathrm{Split}(\Lambda,\Lambda)$?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface the framework of $\mathrm{Split}(\mathcal{U},\mathcal{V})$ developed by Scheepers and Tsaban ("The combinatorics of splittability", math/0212312) and subsequent work on selective covering properties of product spaces, but no source consulted explicitly resolves whether compactness of $X$ plus $\mathrm{Split}(\Lambda,\Lambda)$ for $Y$ implies $\mathrm{Split}(\Lambda,\Lambda)$ for $X\times Y$. The status of this particular product question therefore appears unverified from the available search evidence.

status_evidence.title: The combinatorics of splittability
status_evidence.snippet: Almost complete classification of Split(U,V) properties; discusses preservation under unions, subsets, powers and products.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational reference where products and splittability are studied, but the specific compact×Split(Λ,Λ) product question is left as an open direction.

status_evidence.title: Selective covering properties of product spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies selective covering properties (Menger, Hurewicz, Rothberger, Scheepers) under products.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work on products and selection principles does not provide a clear resolution of the Split(Λ,Λ) compact-product problem.
